here is another bug. add N amount of outliners ->
  create group -> toggle visiblity for group to off ->
  save to disk -> restart -> all of the grouped items
  will list, they do not exist though -> restart again
  -> they no longer exist in the outliner list at all
resolution: Hidden outliner geometry is no longer omitted from durable RJMD saves. The host now composes visible plus hidden face blocks (including source/display verts, groups, texture roles, colors/glass), validates that every serialized face belongs to exactly one declared part and every declared part owns faces, and refuses a metadata-only overwrite. Cold load installs the complete mesh then restores saved hidden ranges without journaling; starting another model clears the old hidden stash. Added Zig snapshot/range regressions and TS hidden-metadata coverage. Native mesh-edit tests, meshDoc 10/10, and the full ReleaseFast editor build pass.
